A bara, ɗakin karatun Greenfield ya rubuta ziyarce-ziyarce 4,000 a Maris. A wannan Maris, ya rubuta 8,000. Daraktan ɗakin karatu ya ce ƙarin ya samo asali ne daga Watan Littafi, wani taron wata ɗaya da ake ba baƙi kofi kyauta. Bayan taron ya ƙare, Afrilu ya sami ziyarce-ziyarce 4,500.

x-e-h2-03.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta wa R. Kim wasiƙa da Turanci mai jimloli 3 zuwa 5. Za ka iya ƙin yarda ko amincewa a wani ɓangare. Ba da dalili guda na musamman (misali ko sharadi), kuma ka yi ladabi.
x-e-h2-03.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko taƙaita a jimla guda ɓangaren layi na 5 na R. Kim da ake shakka a kansa.
x-e-h2-03.s.s2.hint.1: Game da wannan ɓangare, fara da 'However, ...' ko 'I agree ..., but ...' sannan ka ƙara wata jimla mai dalili.
x-e-h2-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: A bayyane yake wace jimlar R. Kim amsarka ta mayar da martani a kanta?
x-e-h2-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ko da ba ka yarda ba, ka yarda da wani ɓangare na ra'ayin ɗayan da za ka iya amincewa da shi?
x-e-h2-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Akwai aƙalla takamaiman misali ko sharadi guda?
x-e-h2-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amincewa da wani ɓangare tare da shawarar a bincika.

x-e-h2-04.title: Sake rubuta daftarin fushi domin masu karatun jarida
x-e-h2-04.goal: A daftarin fushi, ware gaskiya, zato da barazana, sannan ka sake rubuta wasiƙar mai buƙata ga masu karatu (iyaye, malamai da shugaban makaranta).
x-e-h2-04.material:
Wannan daftarin ɗalibin ƙungiya ne da zai aika wa jaridar makaranta. Masu karatu iyaye, malamai da shugaban makaranta ne.

Dear Editor,
Makarantar nan ba ta da adalci! Sun ƙwace ɗakin kiɗa saboda sabon shugaban makaranta ya fi son wasanni. Babu wanda ya damu da kiɗa. A gyara yanzu, in ba haka ba dukkanmu za mu daina zuwa tarukan makaranta!
x-e-h2-04.thinking.1: Canja salo domin masu karatu da manufar rubutu
x-e-h2-04.prereq.1: Furucin buƙata kamar would like to da we ask
x-e-h2-04.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk sassan da za su sa masu karatu daina sauraro ko kuma marubucin ba zai iya tabbatarwa ba.
x-e-h2-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane furuci, tambayi 'Marubucin zai iya tabbatar da wannan kai tsaye?'
x-e-h2-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin wane sashe shugaban makaranta zai so ya ƙalubalanta idan ya karanta.
x-e-h2-04.s.s1.r.a: Abin da ke zuciyar shugaban makaranta zato ne da marubucin ba zai iya tabbatarwa ba.
x-e-h2-04.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ya kusa zama gaskiyar da za a iya tabbatarwa. Idan ka cire shi ma, ainihin jigon wasiƙar zai ɓace.
x-e-h2-04.s.s1.r.c: 'Babu kowa' yana da'awa game da kowa gaba ɗaya, yana kuma yin watsi da waɗanda ke damuwa.
x-e-h2-04.s.s1.r.d: Yana kama da barazana, ba buƙata ba, don haka yana sa masu karatu su mai da martani da kare kansu.
x-e-h2-04.s.s1.explain: b gaskiya ce da ya kamata ta kasance. a (zato game da zuciyar shugaban makaranta), c (da'awa game da kowa) da d (barazana) su ne sassan da masu karatu za su yi wahalar yarda da su.
x-e-h2-04.s.s2.prompt: Riƙe gaskiya da buƙatar, sannan ka sake rubuta wasiƙar da Turanci domin masu karatu (iyaye, malamai da shugaban makaranta). Yi jimloli 3 zuwa 5, ka haɗa matsalar da ƙungiyar ke fuskanta da takamaiman buƙata guda.
x-e-h2-04.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta abubuwa uku da za a cire daga daftarin da abu guda da za a riƙe.
x-e-h2-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bayan gaskiyar da ka riƙe, ci gaba da takamaiman buƙata ta amfani da 'We would like ...' ko 'We ask ...'.
x-e-h2-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Kana ganin shugaban makaranta zai iya karanta ba tare da ya fara kare kansa ba?
x-e-h2-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wasiƙar ta ƙunshi gaskiya, tasirin matsalar da buƙata?
x-e-h2-04.s.s2.modelNote.2: Yanayin da aka yi amfani da 'nobody' a cikin jimlar gaskiya.

x-e-h2-06.topic: saƙonnin imel irin na wurin aiki (imel ɗin aiki)
x-e-h2-06.title: Karanta imel ɗin ƙungiya, sannan ka nemo layin da zai sa mai amsa ya tambaya “Wane taro?”
x-e-h2-06.goal: A cikin daftarin imel da wani memba zai aika, nemo layukan da za su sa mai karɓa ya sake tambaya, sannan ka sake rubuta su domin mai karɓa ya iya ɗaukar mataki ba tare da tambaya ba.
x-e-h2-06.material:
Wannan daftarin imel ne da Sora take son aikawa ga duk ƙungiyar. Ƙungiyar tana da “Sales Review Meeting” ranar Monday da 10:00 da “Design Review Meeting” ranar Wednesday da 15:00; taron da Sora take son matsawa shi ne na Wednesday. Dalili kuwa shi ne abokin ciniki ba zai iya zuwa kuma.

Subject: Meeting
Hi all,
We need to move the meeting to next week because the client can't come.
Please tell me when you are free.
I'll book a room after that.
Sora
x-e-h2-06.thinking.0: Nemo abin da bai fito fili ba daga ra’ayin mai karɓa.
x-e-h2-06.thinking.1: Cika bayanin da ake bukata domin ɗaukar mataki.
x-e-h2-06.thinking.2: Rubuta taken, jiki da wa’adin amsa su dace da juna.
x-e-h2-06.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda da membobin ƙungiyar za su sake tambaya bayan karantawa, kamar “Wane taro ne?” ko “Zuwa yaushe zan amsa?” (Ko da akwai layuka da dama, zaɓi guda ɗaya kawai.)
x-e-h2-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin ko memban ƙungiyar da ya karɓi imel ɗin a karon farko zai tambaya “To me?” game da wani layi.
x-e-h2-06.s.s1.hint.1: Karanta kowane layi, ka tambayi kanka, “To me zan yi, kuma zuwa yaushe?”
x-e-h2-06.s.s1.explain: Layi na 1 (taken) da layi na 3 ba su bayyana wane taro ba, layi na 4 kuma ba shi da wa’adin amsawa. Da yake akwai taruka biyu, “taron” kaɗai bai bayyana wanne ne ba.
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.prompt: Sake rubuta imel ɗin da Turanci, haɗa da taken (Subject). Ka bayyana wane taro ne, dalili, abin da kake nema, da wa’adin amsa. (Kusan kalmomi 60)
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta layi guda ga taken, dalili, buƙata, da wa’adi, sannan ka haɗa su.
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.hint.1: Yi amfani da jerin dubawa domin tabbatar da ka rubuta “wane taro” da “zuwa yaushe”.
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wani da ya karɓi imel ɗin a karon farko zai iya amsawa nan take ba tare da sake tambaya ba?
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Za a iya gane abin da imel ɗin yake game da shi daga taken kaɗai?
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Bayan gyaran, dalilin (abokin ciniki ba zai iya zuwa ba) har yanzu yana bayyana?
x-e-h2-06.s.s2.modelNote.2: An rubuta wa’adin da cewa “zuwa ƙarshen wannan makon”.

x-e-h2-09.title: Nemo sharadin da aka ɓoye a cikin “Ya fi araha, saboda haka mu hau bas”.
x-e-h2-09.goal: Zaɓi zatonta da ba a faɗa ba tsakanin dalili da ƙarshe, sannan ka ƙirƙiri yanayi da Turanci inda dalilin yake gaskiya amma ƙarshe ba daidai ba ne.
x-e-h2-09.material:
Abokin ajinka Jun ya ba da shawarar yadda za a je yawon makaranta zuwa gidan kayan tarihi.

Jun: “Bas ya fi jirgin ƙasa araha, saboda haka ya kamata mu hau bas zuwa gidan kayan tarihi.”

Wannan shi kaɗai ne abin da Jun ya faɗa. Babu wani bayani dabam.
x-e-h2-09.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri yanayi mai misali da ke karyata iƙirarin.
x-e-h2-09.thinking.2: Ƙarfafa iƙirari ta hanyar ƙara sharudda.
x-e-h2-09.prereq.0: Yadda ake amfani da because da so.
x-e-h2-09.prereq.1: Furucin kwatantawa kamar cheap da slow.
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk zatonnin da dole ne su zama gaskiya domin ƙarshe na Jun ya biyo, amma Jun bai faɗa ba.
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta dabam dalili guda da ƙarshe guda daga jimlar Jun.
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin yanayin da ƙarshe zai canza idan dalilin ƙarya ne ko ba shi da muhimmanci.
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.r.a: Wannan shi ne dalilin da Jun ya riga ya bayar. Zato da aka ɓoye abu ne da ba a faɗa ba.
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ra’ayi ne cewa farashi dole ne ya zama muhimmi domin “ya fi araha” ya zama dalili.
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.r.c: Ko gidan kayan tarihin a buɗe yake ya shafi bas da jirgin ƙasa daidai. Shin yana da alaƙa da zaɓen ɗaya daga cikinsu?
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.r.d: Wannan ra’ayi ne cewa ko da dalili gaskiya ne, dole ne wasu sharudda su cika domin ƙarshe ya biyo.
x-e-h2-09.s.s1.explain: Jun bai ce “farashi yana da muhimmanci” ko “bas bai fi muni sosai ta fuskar lokaci ko sauƙi ba” ba, amma dole ne duka su zama gaskiya domin “ya fi araha, saboda haka bas” ya zama ƙarshe. a dalili ne da tuni aka bayyana, c kuma ba shi da alaƙa da zaɓen ɗaya daga zaɓuɓɓukan biyu.
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta jimlolin Turanci ɗaya ko biyu game da yanayin da dalilin Jun (“bas ya fi araha”) yake gaskiya amma ƙarshe (“mu hau bas”) ba daidai ba ne.
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta abubuwa biyu ban da farashi da kake la’akari da su yayin tafiya (lokaci, aminci, aboki mai matsalar motsi).
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.hint.1: Ƙirƙiri a layi guda yanayin bas inda ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan abubuwa babbar matsala ce.
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: A yanayin da ka rubuta, “bas ya fi araha” har yanzu gaskiya ne?
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Za ka iya bayyana a jimla guda dalilin da ya sa ƙarshe ba daidai ba ne a wannan yanayin?
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.modelNote.0: Yana karya zato game da lokaci.
x-e-h2-09.s.s2.modelNote.1: Yana karya zato game da sauƙin isa ga kowa.

x-e-h2-10.title: Ya yi nasara kamfen ɗin sake amfani da kayan roba? Sake tunani yayin da sabon bayani yake zuwa.
x-e-h2-10.topic: Sake duba hukunci da sabon bayanai.
x-e-h2-10.goal: Duba bayanan da aka bayyana tsawon makonni 3, sake duba hukuncinka a kowane lokaci, sannan ka bayyana da Turanci bayanin da ya canza hukuncinka.
x-e-h2-10.material: Makaranta ta fara kamfen na sake sarrafa kwalaben roba. Kafin kamfen, kwalabe 120 a rana a matsakaici suna shiga kwandon shara na gama-gari, 10 kuma suna shiga kwandon sake sarrafawa. Tambayar ita ce, “Kamfen ɗin ya yi nasara?” Za ka duba bayanai mako ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
x-e-h2-10.thinking.0: Sake duba hukunci bisa sabon bayani.
x-e-h2-10.prereq.1: Furucin lokaci kamar at first da later.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.prompt: Karanta sabon bayanin kowane mako, sannan ka yanke hukuncin da ya dace zuwa yanzu.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.hint.0: Nemo sabon lamba ko abin da ya faru guda a bayanan wannan makon.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.hint.1: Bincika ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko hukuncinka na baya ya dace da sabon bayanin.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.info: Mako na 1: kwalaben shara a kowace rana a babban kwandon shara sun ragu daga 120 zuwa 80.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Idan aka duba bayanin Mako na 1 kaɗai, wane hukunci ne ya dace?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Gaskiya ne kwalaben sun ragu a Mako na 1. A wannan lokaci, yana da ma’ana a ɗauka cewa “ya yi aiki”, ko a ce “mako ɗaya ne kawai, mu ci gaba da lura”.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya dogara da gaskiyar cewa adadin ya ragu. Ka kuma yi tunani game da iyakarsa: bayanin mako ɗaya ne kawai.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Hukunci ne mai taka-tsantsan bisa shaida, yana jinkirta ƙarshe tabbatacce domin mako ɗaya kaɗai aka lura.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Gaskiya ne 80 sun rage, amma ta yaya za ka bayyana raguwar daga 120?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Mako na 2: tafiyar makaranta ta tafi da ɗalibai 100 daga cikin 400 daga Wednesday zuwa Friday. Kwalaben shara a rana: 70.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yaya za ka gyara hukuncinka bayan ganin sabon bayani?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Tun da yawan ɗaliban ya ragu da kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu, ba za a iya tantance ko kwalaben sun ragu saboda kamfen ko saboda ɗalibai sun ragu ba. Rage ƙwarin gwiwa ya dace.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Idan kwalaben sun ragu a makon da ɗalibai suka ragu, bincika ko kamfen kaɗai ne dalilin raguwar.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya kuma yi la’akari da wani bayani dabam, canjin yawan ɗalibai.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Idan ɗalibai 100 ba sa nan, kwalaben da ake zubarwa ma na iya raguwa. Bincika ko wannan bayani ne da za ka iya yin watsi da shi.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.info: Mako na 3: duk ɗalibai sun dawo. Kwalaben shara a rana: 75. Kwandon sake sarrafawa yanzu yana da kwalabe 60 a rana (kafin kamfen yana da 10 a rana).
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Bayan ganin bayanan ƙarshe, wane hukunci ne yake da mafi kyawun shaida?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Kwalaben shara 75 + kwalaben sake sarrafawa 60 = 135, kusan iri ɗaya da 120 + 10 = 130 kafin kamfen. Yawan kwalaben bai ragu ba, amma sauyawa zuwa kwandon sake sarrafawa shi ne tasirin kamfen.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya duba gaskiyar cewa adadin bai kusanci 0 ba kawai. Yaya za ka karanta adadin da ke kwandon sake sarrafawa?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Idan ka duba kwandon shara kaɗai, adadin ya ragu; amma ka kwatanta jimillar da kwandon sake sarrafawa (75+60 da 120+10).
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan hukunci ne da ya kwatanta jimillar kwandon shara da kwandon sake sarrafawa tare.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.reflect: Yaya hukuncinka ya canza daga mako zuwa mako? Idan ya canza, ambaci wani bayani guda (jimla guda) da ya jawo canjin.
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta jimlolin Turanci 2 zuwa 3 game da yadda hukuncinka ya canza. Faɗi bayanan makon da suka canza tunaninka.
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta layi guda ga zaɓin da ka yi a kowane mako, sannan ka yi alama inda ya canza.
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.hint.1: A wurin da ya canza, haɗa “because” da wani sabon bayani guda.
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Za a iya ganin hukuncinka na farko, dalilin da ya sa ka yi shakka a tsakiya, da hukuncinka na ƙarshe?
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Hukuncinka na ƙarshe yana samun goyon baya daga lambobin bayanan Mako na 3?
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Maimakon cewa “tabbatacce ne”, ka yi amfani da matakin ƙwarin gwiwa da ya dace da bayanan?
